answer: A resistant economy prices identity by continuous verifiable pulse, not by one-time signup. Every account posts collateral and must keep re-proving judgment on fresh randomized tasks, scored by a non-kin jury; cloning multiplies the collateral and compute each forged node must carry, while reputation compounds only on honest work. A fake cluster finds no safe terrace, its jade-like value eroding faster than upkeep, so mass impersonation cannot pay for itself.
